_general.title: A noisy neighbour
_general.text: Hammering next door all day long.
_general.success: You tune it out and keep working.

_general.title: A lucky find
_general.text: Something glints in the gutter on your way home.

_general.title: Heavy rain
_general.text: The sky opens and stays open.
_general.success: You don't mind a little water.

_general.title: A letter
_general.text: A letter arrives from someone you haven't heard from in a long time.

_general.title: A stranger
_general.text: A stranger in fine clothes asks for directions.

success.text: They are who they say, and tip you for the help.

failure.text: A pickpocket's partner. Your purse is lighter.

_general.title: A beggar
_general.text: An old soldier begs by the road.
_general.success: He is genuine, and repays you with a rumour (DM's choice).

failure.text: You give a coin to a liar.

_general.title: A stray dog
_general.text: A scruffy dog starts following you.
_general.success: It's friendly, and keeps you company all day.

_general.title: A town feast
_general.text: The town celebrates a saint's day.

success.text: Spirits are high and the food is free.

_general.title: Questions from the watch
_general.text: The watch stops you about a theft nearby.
_general.success: They let you go with an apology.

failure.text: They hold you for the afternoon.

_general.title: A head cold
_general.text: Your nose starts running.

failure.text: You spend the day in bed.

_general.title: The tax collector
_general.text: A clerk wants a road tax from everyone.

_general.title: Overheard
_general.text: Two people whisper about something they shouldn't.

_general.title: A street fight
_general.text: Two men brawl in the street.

success.text: You break it up and a shopkeeper thanks you.

failure.text: A stray punch lands on you.

_general.title: A lost purse
_general.text: A purse lies in the road with a name stitched inside.

success.text: You return it. The owner rewards you.

_general.title: Bumped
_general.text: Someone bumps into you in the crowd.
_general.success: You keep a hand on your purse.

_general.title: A good meal
_general.text: The inn has a new cook.

_general.title: Bad sleep
_general.text: The bed is lumpy and the walls are thin.

_general.title: An old face
_general.text: Someone from your past is in town.

_general.title: A falling sign
_general.text: A shop sign swings loose above you.
_general.success: You step aside as it falls.

_general.title: A runaway cart
_general.text: A cart rolls down the hill with no driver.

success.text: You stop it. The owner pays you.

_general.title: A helping hand
_general.text: A stranger offers to help with your work.

pre-work.title: A fight breaks out
pre-work.text: Two customers start swinging at each other.

success.text: You throw them out. The boss tips you.

failure.text: A chair catches you on the way past.

pre-work.title: Light fingers
pre-work.text: A pickpocket is working the room.

success.text: You catch them. A small reward.

pre-work.title: A generous patron
pre-work.text: A traveller takes a liking to you.

pre-work.title: A dropped tray
pre-work.text: You trip with a full tray of drinks.

success.text: You catch it all. A cheer from the bar.

failure.text: Broken glass comes out of your wages.

pre-work.title: A hard foreman
pre-work.text: The foreman wants the work done twice as fast.

success.text: You keep up and earn a bonus.

failure.text: He sends you home. The day doesn't count.

pre-work.title: A sick coworker
pre-work.text: Someone on your shift is coughing badly.

success.text: You get them home. Their family thanks you.

failure.text: You catch it too and lose a day.

pre-work.title: A lost child
pre-work.text: A small child is crying by the door.

success.text: You find their parents, who press a coin on you.

pre-work.title: Short-changed
pre-work.text: The paymaster counts your wages quickly.

success.text: You notice the short count and get the rest.

failure.text: You find out later you were cheated.

pre-work.title: A rush delivery
pre-work.text: A crate must cross town before the bell.

success.text: You make it with time to spare.

pre-work.title: A noble in disguise
pre-work.text: A plainly dressed customer has very soft hands.

success.text: You spot who they are and serve them well.

pre-work.title: Fire in the kitchen
pre-work.text: A pan of oil catches.

success.text: You smother it. The owner owes you.

pre-work.title: An extra shift
pre-work.text: The boss asks you to stay late.

success.text: You earn a little more and go home tired.

pre-work.title: A riddling regular
pre-work.text: An old man pays only if you answer his riddle.

pre-work.title: A stubborn mule
pre-work.text: The cart mule won't move.

pre-work.title: A rotten ladder
pre-work.text: A rung snaps under your foot.

pre-work.title: Guild trouble
pre-work.text: A guild enforcer says you need a permit to work here.
pre-work.success: You talk your way out of the fee.

pre-work.title: Talent spotted
pre-work.text: A merchant likes how you work.

pre-work.title: A strike
pre-work.text: The workers down tools over pay.

success.text: You help settle it and everyone gets a raise.

failure.text: No work and no pay today.

pre-work.title: A clipped coin
pre-work.text: A customer pays with a shaved coin.

success.text: You catch it and they pay properly.

pre-work.title: A quiet day
pre-work.text: Nothing much happens and the time flies.

success.text: You get ahead on the work.

pre-work.title: An old friend
pre-work.text: Someone from your past walks in.

success.text: You catch up over a drink they pay for.

pre-carouse.title: Drinking contest
pre-carouse.text: A dwarf slams a tankard down in front of you.

success.text: You win the pot and the crowd.

pre-carouse.title: An old rival
pre-carouse.text: Someone you crossed is at the bar.
pre-carouse.failure: They remember you, and not kindly (DM's choice).

pre-carouse.title: A friendly card game
pre-carouse.text: There's a seat open at the table.

success.text: You read the table and win.

pre-carouse.title: A bard's challenge
pre-carouse.text: A bard calls you up to sing.

pre-carouse.title: Spilled ale
pre-carouse.text: A big man says you spilled his drink.

success.text: You buy him a round and make a friend.

pre-carouse.title: Arm wrestling
pre-carouse.text: A half-orc slaps her elbow on the table.

failure.text: You lose the bet and nearly your arm.

pre-carouse.title: Loose talk
pre-carouse.text: A drunk is boasting about a hidden vault.
pre-carouse.success: You can tell it's true (DM's choice).

pre-carouse.title: A charming stranger
pre-carouse.text: Someone very charming gets very close.
pre-carouse.success: You catch their hand in your purse.

pre-carouse.title: A hazy morning
pre-carouse.text: You wake up with a ring on your finger.
pre-carouse.success: You remember everything. It was a joke.
pre-carouse.failure: You have no idea who you married (DM's choice).

pre-carouse.title: Knucklebones
pre-carouse.text: A dice game in the back room.

failure.text: Caught palming a die and thrown out.

pre-carouse.title: A private party
pre-carouse.text: You blag your way into a noble's party.
pre-carouse.success: You make a useful friend (DM's choice) and eat well.

pre-carouse.title: The toast
pre-carouse.text: You're asked to toast the guest of honour.

success.text: A rousing speech. Free drinks all night.

pre-carouse.title: Grey stew
pre-carouse.text: The tavern stew is an odd colour.

failure.text: You lose the next day to it.

pre-carouse.title: Sailors' tales
pre-carouse.text: A ship's crew in port tells stories.
pre-carouse.success: One tale matches an old map you saw (DM's choice).

pre-carouse.title: Tables go flying
pre-carouse.text: The whole tavern erupts.

success.text: You stay standing and pocket a dropped purse.

failure.text: You wake up under a table.

pre-carouse.title: The watch arrives
pre-carouse.text: A raid on the gambling den.

failure.text: A night in the cells and a fine.

pre-carouse.title: A generous drunk
pre-carouse.text: A merchant just closed a big deal.

success.text: He buys the whole bar a round.

pre-carouse.title: Where are my boots?
pre-carouse.text: You come home without your boots.

pre-carouse.title: A secret admirer
pre-carouse.text: A note is slipped under your tankard.
pre-carouse.success: You spot who sent it (DM's choice).

pre-carouse.title: A broken lute string
pre-carouse.text: The band's lute player snaps a string mid-song.

success.text: You fill in with a drinking song. Free drinks.

pre-carouse.title: A palm reader
pre-carouse.text: A woman offers to read your palm for a coin.
pre-carouse.success: You see past the act and she gives you a real warning (DM's choice).

pre-pray.title: A sign
pre-pray.text: The candles gutter all at once.

pre-pray.title: An orphan
pre-pray.text: A child begs on the temple steps.

success.text: You give what you can. A priest notices.

pre-pray.title: A heretic preacher
pre-pray.text: A loud stranger mocks the faith outside.
pre-pray.success: You win the argument and the crowd.

pre-pray.title: A sick pilgrim
pre-pray.text: A traveller collapses during prayers.

success.text: You tend them. The priests thank you.

pre-pray.failure: There is little you can do.

pre-pray.title: The relic
pre-pray.text: The temple shows its relic today.
pre-pray.success: You notice a detail no one else sees (DM's choice).

pre-pray.title: The donation box
pre-pray.text: Someone is reaching into the box.

success.text: You stop them. The priest blesses you.

pre-pray.title: A fast
pre-pray.text: The priests ask everyone to fast for the day.

success.text: A clear mind and a strong spirit.

pre-pray.title: The choir
pre-pray.text: The choir needs one more voice.
pre-pray.failure: You crack on the high note.

pre-pray.title: Another priest
pre-pray.text: A priest of another god asks pointed questions.
pre-pray.success: A respectful talk, and a new contact.

pre-pray.title: A bad omen
pre-pray.text: A crow lands on the altar.
pre-pray.success: You read it as a warning (DM's choice).

pre-pray.title: A confession
pre-pray.text: A stranger confesses something to you, thinking you are a priest.
pre-pray.success: You know they speak the truth (DM's choice).
pre-pray.failure: You can't tell if it's true.

pre-pray.title: A leaking roof
pre-pray.text: The roof leaks over the altar.

success.text: You patch it. The priests pay for the work.

pre-pray.title: A blessing
pre-pray.text: The high priest passes by.

success.text: They bless you on the way.

pre-pray.title: The tithe
pre-pray.text: The temple asks for a gift.

pre-pray.title: A cold pew
pre-pray.text: One pew is always cold.

success.text: You lay a restless spirit to rest.

pre-pray.title: An old prayer book
pre-pray.text: A forgotten book behind the altar.
pre-pray.success: It holds a prayer no one has said in years (DM's choice).
pre-pray.failure: The pages crumble in your hands.

pre-pray.title: Pilgrims arrive
pre-pray.text: A large group needs beds for the night.

success.text: You find them all a place. A small gift.

pre-pray.title: Your sermon
pre-pray.text: The priest asks you to speak.

pre-pray.title: The infirmary
pre-pray.text: The temple's sick ward is busy.

success.text: You help, and learn a thing or two.

pre-pray.title: Thick incense
pre-pray.text: The smoke is very thick today.

pre-pray.title: A small miracle
pre-pray.text: A candle lights itself as you pray.

pre-gather.title: Wolves
pre-gather.text: Grey shapes move between the trees.

success.text: You slip away and find a rare root on the way.

failure.text: You run, dropping half of what you gathered.

pre-gather.title: A rare bloom
pre-gather.text: A flower you've only read about.

success.text: Worth a good price to an alchemist.

pre-gather.failure: You pick it wrong and it wilts.

pre-gather.title: A bee nest
pre-gather.text: The best patch is under a hive.

success.text: You gather around them, and take some honey.

pre-gather.title: Sinking ground
pre-gather.text: The path turns to sucking mud.

failure.text: You lose your basket in the mud.

pre-gather.title: A rash
pre-gather.text: You brushed against something you shouldn't have.
pre-gather.success: You know the cure and pick it nearby.

pre-gather.title: Lost in the woods
pre-gather.text: The trail is gone.

success.text: You find the way, and a good patch on it.

pre-gather.title: A wild boar
pre-gather.text: It snorts and paws the ground.
pre-gather.success: It loses interest and wanders off.

pre-gather.title: A hermit
pre-gather.text: An old woman tends a garden deep in the woods.

success.text: She trades you seeds for news.

pre-gather.failure: She sets her goose on you.

pre-gather.title: A ring of mushrooms
pre-gather.text: A perfect circle of mushrooms in a clearing.
pre-gather.success: You leave it alone, wisely, and find a fey trinket outside it (DM's choice).

failure.text: You step in, and lose a day you can't account for.

pre-gather.title: A snake
pre-gather.text: Something moves in the long grass.

pre-gather.title: A poacher's trap
pre-gather.text: Steel jaws hidden in the leaves.

success.text: You spring it safely and keep it.

pre-gather.title: A storm
pre-gather.text: The sky turns black in minutes.

failure.text: Soaked and chilled to the bone.

pre-gather.title: Fine weather
pre-gather.text: A perfect day for gathering.

success.text: You get far more done than usual.

pre-gather.title: Truffles
pre-gather.text: A farmer's pig is digging at something.

success.text: Truffles, and the farmer doesn't know.

pre-gather.title: A ranger
pre-gather.text: A ranger warns you off the king's land.
pre-gather.success: They let you pick, and show you a good spot.

pre-gather.title: Big tracks
pre-gather.text: Fresh tracks, very large and very close.

failure.text: You meet the one who made them.

pre-gather.title: A clear spring
pre-gather.text: Cold clear water among the rocks.

pre-gather.title: Bright berries
pre-gather.text: They look tasty.

success.text: Safe and delicious. You pick a basket.

pre-gather.title: A quiet camp
pre-gather.text: Smoke rises from a camp in a clearing. Too quiet.

success.text: You slip past, and find a dropped purse.

pre-gather.title: A will-o'-wisp
pre-gather.text: A light bobs between the trees.

pre-gather.title: A high ford
pre-gather.text: The river is up after the rain.

pre-cellar.title: Rats in the cellar!
pre-cellar.text: A swarm of rats boils out of a broken barrel.

success.text: You clear them out. The owner pays extra.

failure.text: Bitten and chased up the stairs. The job isn't done.

pre-cellar.title: A loose brick
pre-cellar.text: Behind a loose brick something glints.

success.text: An old purse someone hid long ago.

pre-cellar.failure: Just a dead spider and a lot of dust.

pre-cellar.title: Spoiled stores
pre-cellar.text: The smell is unbearable down here.
pre-cellar.success: You hold your breath and finish the job.

failure.text: You lose a day being sick.

pre-cellar.title: A huge spider
pre-cellar.text: Webs as thick as rope fill the corner.

success.text: You squash it. The owner pays extra.

pre-cellar.title: A weak beam
pre-cellar.text: The ceiling groans above you.
pre-cellar.success: You prop it up before it falls.

failure.text: Dust and rubble come down on you.

pre-cellar.title: Old wine
pre-cellar.text: A dusty bottle with a noble crest.

success.text: You know its worth. The owner shares the sale.

failure.text: You open it. Delicious, but the owner docks your pay.

pre-cellar.title: Cold breath
pre-cellar.text: Your lantern flickers and something sighs.

failure.text: You run. The job isn't done.

pre-cellar.title: A draught
pre-cellar.text: Air is moving behind a shelf.
pre-cellar.failure: Just a crack in the wall.

pre-cellar.title: Black mould
pre-cellar.text: It covers the far wall.
pre-cellar.success: You know to burn it off.

pre-cellar.title: Water rising
pre-cellar.text: A water pipe bursts.
pre-cellar.success: You plug it with a rag and a wedge.

failure.text: The cellar floods. The owner won't pay.

pre-cellar.title: A squatter
pre-cellar.text: Someone is living down here.
pre-cellar.success: They leave peacefully, and thank you for the warning.

pre-cellar.title: A pleased owner
pre-cellar.text: The owner comes down to look.

success.text: They are happy with the work and pay a bonus.

pre-cellar.title: A cellar snake
pre-cellar.text: Coils under the barrels.

pre-cellar.title: Heavy barrels
pre-cellar.text: Every barrel needs moving.

pre-cellar.title: An old map
pre-cellar.text: Rolled up in a wine rack.
pre-cellar.success: It shows something worth finding (DM's choice).
pre-cellar.failure: It's a map of this cellar.

pre-cellar.title: Smuggled goods
pre-cellar.text: Crates with a strange mark.

success.text: You know to keep quiet, and someone pays you to.

pre-cellar.title: Lantern out
pre-cellar.text: Total darkness.

pre-cellar.title: A kobold
pre-cellar.text: A little scaly face peeks from a hole.

success.text: It trades its stash for your bread.

pre-cellar.title: A cellar cat
pre-cellar.text: A cat follows you down the stairs.

success.text: It hunts the rats for you.

pre-cellar.title: Old bones
pre-cellar.text: A shallow grave under the floor.
pre-cellar.success: You say a short rite and the place feels calmer.

pre-cellar.title: Rotten floor
pre-cellar.text: A board cracks under your foot.

failure.text: You fall through to the sub-cellar.

pre-recuperate.title: A deep sleep
pre-recuperate.text: You sleep for twelve hours.

pre-recuperate.title: Nightmares
pre-recuperate.text: Old fights replay in your dreams.

pre-recuperate.title: A wandering healer
pre-recuperate.text: A healer offers to look at you.

failure.text: A quack. They take your coin.

pre-recuperate.title: A noisy inn
pre-recuperate.text: Revelry downstairs all night.

pre-recuperate.title: An old wound
pre-recuperate.text: A wound turns red and hot.

pre-recuperate.title: A warm broth
pre-recuperate.text: The innkeeper's family cooks for you.

pre-recuperate.title: A visitor
pre-recuperate.text: An old friend comes to sit with you.

pre-recuperate.title: Fever
pre-recuperate.text: You burn up in the night.

pre-recuperate.title: Bedbugs
pre-recuperate.text: You itch all over.

pre-recuperate.title: Bitter tea
pre-recuperate.text: A neighbour brings a bitter tea.

success.text: You know the leaves. It works.

pre-recuperate.failure: It tastes awful and does nothing.

pre-recuperate.title: Restless
pre-recuperate.text: You itch to get moving.

pre-recuperate.title: The bath house
pre-recuperate.text: Hot water and steam.

pre-recuperate.title: A noise at the door
pre-recuperate.text: Something scrapes at the lock in the night.
pre-recuperate.success: You wake and scare off a thief.

failure.text: Your purse is gone in the morning.

pre-recuperate.title: The physician's bill
pre-recuperate.text: The physician sends a bill.

pre-recuperate.title: A sunny window
pre-recuperate.text: Sun pours through the window.

success.text: You sit in it and feel better.

pre-recuperate.title: Temple prayers
pre-recuperate.text: A priest offers prayers for your health.

pre-recuperate.title: A purring cat
pre-recuperate.text: A cat sleeps on your chest.

success.text: You sleep better than you have in weeks.

pre-recuperate.title: Damp weather
pre-recuperate.text: Your joints ache in the cold.

pre-recuperate.title: A short walk
pre-recuperate.text: The healer says to walk a little.

pre-recuperate.title: Boredom
pre-recuperate.text: Day after day of nothing.
pre-recuperate.success: You catch up on old letters.

failure.text: You sneak out to the tavern.

pre-recuperate.title: An apprentice healer
pre-recuperate.text: A young healer wants to practise on you.

pre-rumours.title: Followed
pre-rumours.text: Someone has been asking about you too.
pre-rumours.success: You lose them, and learn who sent them (DM's choice).

failure.text: They corner you in an alley.

pre-rumours.title: A greedy guard
pre-rumours.text: A guard knows something, for a price.

failure.text: He takes your coin and lies.

pre-rumours.title: A street kid
pre-rumours.text: A child says they know everything, for a copper.
pre-rumours.failure: They take the copper and run.

pre-rumours.title: Tavern gossip
pre-rumours.text: The barmaid hears everything.
pre-rumours.success: She tells you a juicy rumour (DM's choice).
pre-rumours.failure: She's had enough of your questions.

pre-rumours.title: The wrong door
pre-rumours.text: You knock on the wrong house.

pre-rumours.title: A posted notice
pre-rumours.text: A notice on the board looks forged.
pre-rumours.success: You learn who forged it, and why (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.title: An informant
pre-rumours.text: A shady man offers a secret.
pre-rumours.failure: It's a lie to lead you astray (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.title: Marks on the walls
pre-rumours.text: Chalk marks on doorframes all down the street.

pre-rumours.title: The town crier
pre-rumours.text: News from the capital.
pre-rumours.success: You see what it really means (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.title: A drunk noble
pre-rumours.text: He's saying far too much.

pre-rumours.title: Someone else asking
pre-rumours.text: Another person is chasing the same story.

pre-rumours.title: The sewer route
pre-rumours.text: The quickest way is underground.
pre-rumours.success: You come out right where you need to be.

pre-rumours.title: A fortune teller
pre-rumours.text: She knows more than she should.
pre-rumours.success: A hint about your past (DM's choice).

failure.text: She takes a coin and tells you nothing.

pre-rumours.title: A new song
pre-rumours.text: A bard sings about something that happened last week.
pre-rumours.success: The details match what you've heard.

pre-rumours.title: A planted rumour
pre-rumours.text: The same story from three people, word for word.
pre-rumours.success: You know it was planted, and by whom (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.title: Market chatter
pre-rumours.text: Merchants talk prices and news.

pre-rumours.title: At the docks
pre-rumours.text: A sailor saw something odd at sea.

success.text: He tells you for a drink (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.failure: He tells you to get lost.

pre-rumours.title: Gang turf
pre-rumours.text: You've wandered somewhere you shouldn't be.

failure.text: They rough you up and take your coin.

pre-rumours.title: A dropped letter
pre-rumours.text: A courier drops a letter in the street.
pre-rumours.success: You read it before handing it back (DM's choice).

pre-rumours.title: An old resident
pre-rumours.text: She's lived here eighty years.

success.text: She knows the story behind the rumour.

failure.text: She talks about her cats for hours.

pre-rumours.title: A good lead
pre-rumours.text: A name comes up twice in one morning.

success.text: A good lead falls into your lap.

pre-research.title: A forbidden shelf
pre-research.text: A locked case of books the librarian won't talk about.

success.text: Something you weren't meant to read (DM's choice).

failure.text: Caught. You are barred for a day.

pre-research.title: A helpful sage
pre-research.text: An old scholar notices what you're reading.

success.text: They point you to the right book.

pre-research.failure: They lecture you for an hour.

pre-research.title: A tipped candle
pre-research.text: Your candle tips toward an old scroll.

failure.text: You scorch a page and pay for it.

pre-research.title: A cipher
pre-research.text: A note in the margin is in code.

success.text: You crack it. A hidden clue (DM's choice).

pre-research.title: Misfiled
pre-research.text: The book isn't where the catalogue says.

pre-research.title: A rival scholar
pre-research.text: Someone else wants the same book.

success.text: You share it and both learn more.

pre-research.title: Bookworms
pre-research.text: The pages are eaten through.

pre-research.title: Library fees
pre-research.text: The library raises its fees.

pre-research.title: Glowing dust
pre-research.text: You sneeze and the dust glows.
pre-research.success: A trace of old magic, and a clue (DM's choice).

pre-research.title: Working late
pre-research.text: You're close to an answer.

failure.text: You fall asleep on the books and wake at noon.

pre-research.title: The map room
pre-research.text: An old map shows a place you're reading about.

pre-research.title: A public lecture
pre-research.text: A famous scholar speaks today.
pre-research.failure: You get lost in the jargon.

pre-research.title: Silence!
pre-research.text: The librarian glares at you.

pre-research.title: A specimen jar
pre-research.text: A pickled thing in a jar.

success.text: You know what it is, which helps.

pre-research.failure: It seems to look back at you.

pre-research.title: The ghost reader
pre-research.text: A spectral scholar haunts the stacks.

success.text: It helps you find the right page.

failure.text: It knocks books onto your head.

pre-research.title: A good index
pre-research.text: The book has a perfect index.

pre-research.title: A curious student
pre-research.text: A student asks what you're working on.

pre-research.title: A trapped book
pre-research.text: The lock on the book is warm to the touch.

success.text: You undo the glyph. A rare text (DM's choice).
